column7: A near-miss prewarm(model:transcript:) signature compiles but never binds; the framework's default no-op runs instead.
On the 26 SDK MLXFoundationModels builds as an empty library; import succeeds and the late error blames your call site.
Do not hardcode 4096: Apple documents 4096 for iOS 27, but contextSize is dynamic and the third-party 8K device report…
Apple's documented PCC URL 404s; the live path is developer.apple.com/private-cloud-compute/ — entitlement is managed.
Only Core AI's graph compiler is OS-resident; the LLM runtime ships as Swift code in your app, despite Apple's framing.
Pipelined Core AI samples on-GPU with no logits; a correct provider must throw on schema requests, not approximate.
mlx-swift-lm main is a breaking 3.x that split tokenizer and downloader packages — pin a version.
BYO-model @Generable leaves MLX or sequential Core AI; MLX keeps logit tooling without a slower engine.
Correction: MLX does run on iPhone via mlx-swift — only the ANE is closed to it; an earlier community claim erred.
buildURLRequest sniffs 'v1' in baseURL pathComponents; servers on any other version path get broken URLs (FB23837262).
Every table warning is one fact: pipelined Core AI has no logits, so no @Generable — read 5.1 before relying on a row.
The system model is sealed — no weight swaps, no custom LoRA on OS 27; specific models mean Core AI or MLX.
Past 4,096 tokens you need PCC (32K) or a Core AI/MLX model; the Core AI branch carries the @Generable caveat.
Reasoning needs PCC levels or a Core AI/MLX reasoning model; SystemLanguageModel does not reason.
Core AI's fastest engine has no logits so .guidedGeneration is off — and every Core AI benchmark used that engine.
Apple FM measures 0.11 J/token, ~2x better than GPU runtimes and ~4x the CoreML/ANE path; bundles are engine-dependent.
GPU runtimes shed 50-60% of throughput over 10 sustained minutes on iPhone 17 Pro; the ANE retains ~65-67%.
The robust ANE win is GPU exclusivity, not speed — inference off-GPU keeps the UI's GPU free; MLX cannot reach this.
Without AOT + AIModelCache, cold specialization stalls launch: ~4.8 s at 0.8B, ~29 s at 2.3 GB, 194 s for one 3 GB…
supportsGuidedGeneration: is a flag you assert, not a probe — claim it and schema enforcement rests on your server.
Meta note: every warning row above is the same Generable-vs-fastest-engine fact wearing a different hat.
Bring your own model and you lose @Generable exactly when picking the fastest backend — stated nowhere by Apple.
Recurrent-state models (SSM/Mamba2) refuse KV rewind; the running scan cannot truncate, so every edit re-prefills.
trimKVCache(to:) returns negative on unsupported rewind, nothing throws — chats hit 23 s/turn on the wrong model.
All seven Core AI benchmark rows used the no-@Generable pipelined engine — for guided generation the config is…
The 2.47x claim rests on a stale macOS 26 export (~500 tok/s re-exported) and a Debug-build MLX baseline on iPhone.
Source retention numbers conflict (38% vs 64-67% MLX); keep only the qualitative point — GPU throttles, ANE holds.
prewarm has a default no-op extension; a near-miss signature never binds and session.prewarm() quietly does nothing.
Version mistakes here yield empty libraries, dead catches, evaporating #if code, error -1 — rarely a real diagnostic.
Session 330 calls the tensor-ops API 'new in 27'; the header floor is 26.2 — only the quantized macro is 27.0.
Docs and session 339 promise watchOS support, but SystemLanguageModel and its types carry no watchOS 27 availability.
Xcode 27 adds Transcript.Reasoning/AttachmentSegment payloads; 26-era switches fall to default or stop compiling.
A false canImport(_version:) doesn't error — guarded code ceases to exist and the library builds empty.
MLXFoundationModels is empty on the 26 SDK: import and build succeed; 'cannot find MLXLanguageModel' blames your code.
A rebuild under Xcode 27 changes which catch fires; deprecated GenerationError arms go dead without any diagnostic.
catch GenerationError compiles under Xcode 27 but never fires — new error types drop every tested path into bare catch.
Apple's three-arm catch omits SystemLanguageModel.Error, unreachable via LanguageModelError — those failures fall…
Below-floor devices get no .aimodelc; on-device respecialization brings back the multi-second first-launch stall.
A deployment target under 26.2 defines MLX_METAL_NO_NAX and drops every NAX kernel; only a scrolled CMake warning says…
isAvailable == true is not a promise that a request will succeed — treat availability as advisory only.
isAvailable == true yet requests fail with error -1 wrapping undocumented ModelManagerError 1046, even on real devices.
PCC's Small Business condition is reconstructed — on the dev site, in no WWDC transcript; confirm before planning on it.
Constructing PrivateCloudComputeLanguageModel without its entitlement is a fatalError crash, not a catchable throw.
The Simulator on a macOS 27 host runs the host's model, not your target's; adapters are broken outright (issue…
The Simulator on a macOS 26 host emits meaningless -1 errors — pure host/SDK version skew (thread 831404).
Background FM execution is OS-throttled with no priority control (thread 833666).
The Shortcuts 'Use Model' action works but errors cannot be detected — failures pass silently (thread 813757).
A preflight verdict of .onDeviceOnly/.cloudOnly is no success guarantee; wrap each respond in the three-arm catch.
